computedImports.packages/agent/src/definitions/load.ts: definition modules (agents/<name>/index.mjs, jobs/<name>/index.mjs, conversations/<name>/index.mjs) of the application being loaded

adapters.why: BORING-7: the environment and vendor SDKs are touched only inside an adapter folder, packages/<package>/src/adapters/<port>/<name>/. The runtime reaches a port's adapters only through that port's table, packages/<package>/src/adapters/<port>/index.ts; an adapter imports core code as types only and never another adapter.

fsAllowed.packages/agent/src/definitions/load.ts: reads the application's own definition folder (the AppRegistry the host hands the runtime), not deployment state
fsAllowed.packages/files/src/directory.ts: the directory FileProvider: an implementation of the files provider contract (FILES-*, its conformance suite), published at its path since before the adapter folders
